name: viva-payments-monorepo
description: Viva Wallet plugin for Medusa v2 and Vendure (ISV multi-tenant). Monorepo root.

scripts.precheck: pnpm -F @sakeetech/viva-payments-core build && pnpm -r --filter='./packages/*' typecheck && pnpm -r --filter='./packages/*' test
scripts.release:next:dry: pnpm -r --filter='./packages/*' build && pnpm -r --filter='./packages/*' publish --tag next --access public --no-git-checks --dry-run
scripts.release:next: pnpm -r --filter='./packages/*' build && pnpm -r --filter='./packages/*' publish --tag next --access public --no-git-checks
